contract_under_test.input_normalization: each C field: float32 -> Decimal(str(float(Decimal(exact_binary_string)))) -> quantize(0.01, ROUND_HALF_UP); exact-binary f32 tails excluded
contract_under_test.event_reference: ref = (prev_close - C1/10 + C4*C2/10) / ((10+C3+C4)/10); displayed 昨结口径 = ref_cent = quantize(ref, 0.01, ROUND_HALF_UP); prev_close = raw .day close of the bar immediately before the event
contract_under_test.qfq_chain: front-adjustment for a bar at date d = affine composition over events with event_date > d, accumulated oldest->newest: A=A/s, B=(B-d_+a_)/s with d_=C1/10, a_=C4*C2/10, s=(10+C3+C4)/10; NO intermediate cent rounding; anchored at latest bar
contract_under_test.arithmetic: Decimal, context precision 50; all displayed comparisons quantize(0.01, ROUND_HALF_UP); source-precision comparisons quantize(1E-10)
